name: C.A.K.E. Summer Camp (Creative Arts at Keene)
description_short: A four-week multi-arts day camp in July for students in grades 3–12. Campers choose their own full-day or half-day schedule of performing and visual arts classes, and the camp ends with a Festival Week of performances and exhibits.

warnings: Old season: the page describes the 2026 camp (July 6–31, 2026), which is over as of 2026-10-13. 2027 details are not posted yet. Prices may change.

Dates conflict: the summary says July 6–31, 2026, but the week list says 'Week 1: July 5-9 ... Week 4: July 26-30'. In 2026, July 5 was a Sunday, so the week list may be from another year. Dates were left off the individual weeks.

Prices conflict: the early-bird price is 'All four weeks of camp for $890' if registered before May 1, and the standard price is $990 for 4 weeks. The weekly prices listed are $255 full day and $135 half day. Aftercare is $20 per day.
Discounts: a 5% sibling discount is offered, but it cannot be combined with the early-bird price. Payment plans are available. Registration forms were due by June 29 (2026 season).
Week 4 (Festival Week) can't be booked on its own. Campers must also register for Week 1, 2, or 3.
